nodes.label: Human demonstration
nodes.desc: One phone video + hurobo's extracted DemoSpec JSON (keyframes, object-relative summary).

nodes.label: Prompt generator
nodes.desc: Offline Muse Spark call: samples keyframe frames + the DemoSpec summary, writes the demonstration paragraph a generator prompt uses. Guaranteed to reproduce the hand-coded bowl-on-plate template.

nodes.label: Scene reconstruction (cuRobo Mapper)
nodes.desc: Offline probe, not yet in an owned package: orbits a LIBERO camera, fuses RGB-D frames into a cuRobo Mapper TSDF/ESDF, extracts a mesh. Logged 2026-11-03: 16 frames, 23,441-vertex mesh, matches the real scene. Online target: feed compute_esdf() into cuRobo's plan_motion as the collision obstacle, replacing today's single-frame point cloud.

nodes.label: Generator (System 1)
nodes.desc: Frozen Muse Wonder writes a robot program; internal repair loop on the debug seed, cached.

nodes.label: Adversary (System 2)
nodes.desc: Thompson-sampled category selector (not uniform random) attacks the candidate within a bounded severity; never-regress gate decides acceptance.

nodes.label: Muse-Code orchestrator
nodes.desc: Fills harden()'s Generate slot via muse exec: full reasoning-token trace, not just a short WHY note. First real (non-mock) implementation.

nodes.label: Regression gate
nodes.desc: Accepts a candidate only if no worse on every case seen so far and better on at least one.

nodes.label: Recovery-skill module
nodes.desc: Missing piece: generate a small callable recovery skill for a failure mode instead of over-engineering the main policy body.

nodes.label: Deployment (Phase B)
nodes.desc: Perception-only execution; simulator state never substitutes for perception at run time.

nodes.label: Deployment monitor
nodes.desc: Missing piece: detect a new production failure signature, ask a human before re-opening Phase A in parallel simulation.
